## Checklist

- [ ] It is a Python project or a resource about testing Python code.
- [ ] It is open source under an OSI-approved license. It is not a commercial SaaS, a hosted platform, or a client for one.
- [ ] It is maintained, documented, and used by people other than its author.
- [ ] This pull request adds only **one** entry.
- [ ] The entry is in alphabetical order within its section.
- [ ] The entry has the format `- [name](link) - Description.`, and the description is short and contains no marketing language.
- [ ] I am the author or maintainer of this project: yes / no
